senses.definition_en: scarring; cicatrization

examples.english: Janet Hadfield, director of a business called Biotherapy Services, dedicated to the research of that type of plasma, told the BBC that PRP has been used for years to help the scarring of wounds and to treat sports injuries.
examples.ref: 2018 September 13, “Beber sangre humana joven sería la clave para vivir más y mejor”, in Clarín:
examples.text: Janet Hadfield, directora de una empresa llamada Biotherapy Services dedicada a la investigación de ese tipo de plasma, le contó a la BBC que el PRP ha sido utilizado durante años para ayudar a la cicatrización de las heridas y para tratar lesiones deportivas.
examples.translation: Janet Hadfield, director of a business called Biotherapy Services, dedicated to the research of that type of plasma, told the BBC that PRP has been used for years to help the scarring of wounds and to treat sports injuries.
